book.name: Aisaiya
book.title: Aisaiya Aisaiya Bin Gibit Wed Brom God

content: Woning blanga ola pipul hu dumbat nogudbala ting

Wal aibin tok na, “Yumob irrim mi na. YAWEI det trubala God nomo bin lujim im brabli strongbala pawa en im nomo bin jadimap im irriwol. Im gin irrim yumob wen yumob oldei askimbat im en im gin ensim yumob preya.

Im nomo laigim irrim yumob samtaim, dumaji yumob oldei dumbat ola nogudbala ting, en tharran na kadimat yumob brom God. Blanga tharran na im nomo oldei ensim yumob preya en im nomo larram yumob blanga luk langa im feis.
Yumob oldei dalimbat laiya, en yumob oldei wandim kilimbat en faitfaitbat. Yumob jidan brabli giltiwan en yumob bingga oldei jidan garram detmatj blad.
“En yumob nomo gibit feyago langa najalot pipul, en yumob oldei dalimbat laiya langa det kothaus. Yumob oldei dumbat nogudbala ting en meigimbat trabul.

Yumob oldei meigimbat plen blanga dum nogudbala ting langa najalot pipul. Olabat jis laik ol detlot poisinwan sneik weya kamat brom detlot eig blanga det poisinwan sneik. En detlot plen im jis laik yumob trai blanga meigim klos brom det spidaweb, bat yumob kaan meigim klos garram det web en yumob kaan blandim miselp biyain langa tharran, dumaji yumob brabli nogudbala en krulbala.

Yumob oldei go kwikbala blanga dumbat rong ting, o blanga go en medrimbat gudbala pipul. En yumob oldei jinggabat blanga dumbat nogudbala ting. Ebriweya yumob go yumob oldei binijimap ola ebrijing, en yumob libum ebrijing jidan rabishwei.

Yumob nomo sabi hau blanga jidan gudwei, en yumob nomo gibit feyago langa najalot pipul du. Najing. Yumob oldei dumbat nogudbala ting garram yumob laif, en detlot pipul hu bulurrumbat yumob, olabat kaan faindim det gudbalawei.” Lagijat na aibin tok.
Detlot pipul tok sori blanga olabat nogudbalawei
Wal detlot pipul bin tok, “Nobodi bin kaman blanga album melabat en gibit melabat feyago. Melabat bin wandim luk det san weya im oldei shain, bat melabat bin oldei lukinatbat det dakbala.
Melabat oldei wokwokbat jis laik melabat blainwan, en melabat oldei buldan eniweya wen det san im stil langa top, jis laik im stil naitaim. Melabat kaan luk enijing. Melabat jis laik dedbala men.
Melabat jingat soriwei jis laiga hanggriwan beya. Melabat wandim God blanga seibum melabat en gibit melabat feyago, bat najing.
“Haumeni taim melabat bin dum nogudbala ting en gibit bekboun langa yu, YAWEI? Blanga melabat nogudbalawei, im meigim melabat jidan giltiwan. Melabat bin oldei dumbat rong ting.

Melabat bin gibit yu bekboun, en melabat nomo bin laigim bulurrumbat yu. Blanga melabat hat, im oldei dalim melabat blanga kipgon dumbat nogudbala ting en melabat oldei dalimbat laiya. En melabat bin oldei dum krulbala ting langa najalot pipul, en melabat bin gibit bekboun langa yu.
Nomo enibodi gibit feyago langa enibodi. Nomo enibodi tok trubalawei langa det kothaus bat oldei toktok ola laiyawan wed.

Ebribodi oldei dalimbat laiya, en detlot pipul hu oldei gibit bekboun langa det nogudbala ting, olabat abum brabli adtaim na.” Lagijat na detlot pipul bin tok. YAWEI garra seibum im pipul olabat Wal wen YAWEI bin sabi det trubalawei bin gowei, imbin brabli nogudbinji.

En imbin hatjamp en brabli nogudbinji blanga sabi nobodi nomo bin wandim album detlot pipul hu nomo bin abum feyago. En blanga tharran na imbin kaman imselp garram im brabli strongbala pawa blanga seibum olabat en gibit olabat feyago.

YAWEI oldei gibit feyago langa ebribodi jis laik det speshalwan klos weya det solja werrimon blanga fait. En imbin seibum olabat, en tharran jis laik det speshalwan het weya det solja oldei werrimon blanga stapam enijing brom kilimbat im langa hed. Imbin panishim en peiyimbek ebribodi en tharran jis laik detlot speshalwan klos det solja werrimon blanga fait.
Wal YAWEI garra brabli wail en panishim im enamimob blanga wanim olabat bin oldei dumbat langa im pipul olabat. Im garra panishim olabat nomeda olabat jidan gulijap o longwei.
Im garra kaman jis laik det fladwoda en det brabli strongbalawan win. En langa det taim na ola pipul brom sanraiswei en brom sangodanwei garra preisim im brabli gudbala neim en shoum rispek langa im.
Wal YAWEI bin tok, “Ai garra seibum Jerusalem, en detlot bigininimob blanga Jeikob hubin tenim miselp brom olabat nogudbalawei.
En ai meigim dijan strongwan pramis garram yumob. Ai garra gibit yumob main spirit en main mesij. Ai garra gibit olabat langa yumob en yumob femilimob olagijawan.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
